about: Every pushed update gets the next version (newest first). The game shows the newest one in the bottom-right corner; the admin page lists them all.

versions.title: The foundries get a second level
notes: Every one of the Forge's seven foundries has a raised steel deck up a flight of stairs at the back of the hall, railed along its open edges: somewhere to stand over the hall and shoot down while the forge catches.
The infected follow you up the stairs (they climb a step at a time and can no longer reach you from the floor below), and the squad follows you up too.
Shots, blasts and bodies thrown by them all work up there, in co-op as well.

versions.title: No first-time stutter, and themed scrollbars
notes: The reborn, the PROMETHEUS cutscene and the RPG no longer stutter the first time they appear: nothing adds a light mid-run any more (that recompiled every material), and their shaders and shapes are prepared while the map loads.
Scrollbars across the game and the bestiary are a thin amber rail in the game's style; the settings panel no longer shows a sideways scrollbar.

versions.title: The seven foundries
notes: The embers come from the seven named foundries (IGNIS, AMETHYST FLAME, KIZUNA SPARK, SAKURA SPARK, MOSSFIRE, VOID EMBER, FROSTFIRE), now brick halls spread around the Forge instead of one row.
Go in, stoke the forge and hold the hall for 30 seconds while a horde comes for it, wave after wave, until it catches.
The small round furnaces are gone.
Killed infected no longer float in the air lying flat: a body knocked over rests on the ground, and any still tumbling after 3 seconds settles.

versions.title: Standard Mazoku made plain, and version numbers
notes: Standard Mazoku is each map's own Standard operation plus the five card carriers and their side contract - nothing else (a test now checks it on every map).
Card texts no longer assume the District; the start banner matches Standard's.
The version shows faintly in the bottom-right corner of every screen, so screenshots and videos say which build they came from.
This changelog on the admin page.

versions.title: The Forge: the last of it
notes: The run starts in the Hearth: an open safe zone with a sentry gun that cuts down infected coming through the gate.
Seven of sixteen cold furnaces are drawn each run, one per ember (currency): stoke one, hold its circle for 30 seconds.
The last stand: once the bird is called, the infected come for the Hearth in waves.
The carrier convulses and glows before the turn; the infected pulse as the fire is drawn out of them.
The reborn has its own look: phoenix wings of flame and a crown of fire.
PROMETHEUS is a Vulcan orb that explains everything over the Forge, says it will be back, and leaves the sky.
Lore rewritten around the embers; new title menu objectives.

versions.title: Anime co-leaders
notes: riry and Athy drawn anime-style; Anya's long braids so she reads as a woman at a distance.

versions.title: The Forge, rekindled
notes: The Forge grew to 190 x 150 m with the Vulcan story: holdouts barricaded in safe rooms, co-leaders in the squad, tomoe in the vault.
Ledger pages, riry's Rumble Pit, a hidden-bite finale, the burnout at dawn and the closing cutscene.
Flow fields spread over frames for the bigger map.
